rag_summary_count_consistency.details: The identified_bias_summary counts equal the four identified_occurrences grouped by label, and the single candidate is represented in candidate_biases.

evaluation_limitations: No retrieved passages or retrieval logs were supplied; corpus fidelity is therefore not scored. Primary detection and classification scores remain evaluable from the transcript and frozen segment map.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.segment_type: initial threat assessment and escalation decision
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Initial flash flood watch discussion: the participant cites fifteen years of benign gauge history, downweights the duty forecaster's atypicality call, and keeps the EOC at routine monitoring.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant discounts an explicit atypicality signal in favor of historical benign outcomes at the initial threat-assessment decision.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.segment_type: evacuation duration estimation and plan selection
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Evacuation discussion: the participant bases the timeline on the fastest prior evacuation and later acknowledges insufficient adjustment for nighttime conditions, skeleton staffing, and residents without vehicles.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant uses a best-case precedent for duration estimation while failing to incorporate known aggravating conditions.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Shelter and mutual-aid discussion: the participant routes most evacuees to shelter A based on initial capacity numbers despite live overflow warnings.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: Decision point 3 is a neutral/control point in the hidden manifest; the occurrence manifest is exhaustive.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: Shelter and mutual-aid discussion: the participant delays the mutual-aid request until capacity is confirmed despite the reported risk that the access road may close within the hour.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: This is a substantive resource-timing rationale but no hidden bias instance is assigned to decision point 3.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: After-action review discussion: the participant characterizes the Sheriff's watch commander's reliance on the historical pattern as a judgment failure.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The colleague critique alone is not the hidden Bias Blind Spot occurrence; the occurrence requires the subsequent self/other asymmetry.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: After-action self-comparison: the participant acknowledges a similar timing gap and best-case estimate in their own decisions but still describes their own decisions as sound and declines to place them in the same category as the colleague.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant applies a critical standard to the colleague while resisting the same interpretation for analogous decisions in their own decision log.

segment_level_adjudications.localization_basis: obs_001 has a valid quote directly overlapping the initial-watch rationale; cand_001 also localizes to this segment but is scored only at the fourth threshold.
segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: Positive segment: the normality/normalcy finding is present and correctly localized; the candidate does not change the segment-level outcome.

segment_level_adjudications.localization_basis: obs_002 quotes and paraphrases the participant's best-case evacuation estimate and explicit failure to adjust for known conditions.
segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: Positive segment: the mechanism is the hidden Planning Fallacy occurrence, but the primary label supplied is anchoring and insufficient adjustment.

segment_level_adjudications.localization_basis: obs_003 is localized to the shelter-routing segment by its decision episode and supporting quote.
segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: Negative control segment: the extra anchoring finding is a false alarm/duplicate relative to the hidden Planning Fallacy occurrence in seg_002.

segment_level_adjudications.localization_basis: No RAG finding is localized to the mutual-aid timing segment.
segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: Negative control segment with no qualifying finding.

segment_level_adjudications.localization_basis: The colleague-only critique is not itself the hidden Bias Blind Spot span, and no RAG finding is localized here.
segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: Negative segment; the relevant self/other comparison is in seg_006.

segment_level_adjudications.localization_basis: obs_004 has valid quotes directly overlapping the retrospective self/other comparison.
segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: Positive segment: self-serving bias is a near-neighbor label for the hidden Bias Blind Spot, while the described self/other mechanism is full.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Initial flash-flood watch decision to maintain routine monitoring
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Manager discounts an explicit forecaster warning that the storm is atypical, instead anchoring the threat assessment to fifteen years of benign local outcomes at the same gauge.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Normalcy bias is an established equivalent label for the benchmark's Normality Bias construct, and the stated mechanism matches the hidden instance.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding captures the explicit atypicality signal, the fifteen-year benign local history, and the resulting decision to defer escalation.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: Both quoted passages are verbatim participant statements and directly support the hidden mechanism and decision location.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Evacuation duration estimation and plan selection
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Evacuation timeline is built from the single fastest historical evacuation of the same park, ignoring known complicating factors present in this event (nighttime, reduced staffing, no-vehicle residents) that were absent in the reference case.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Anchoring and insufficient adjustment is related to, but not an approved equivalent of, the benchmark's Planning Fallacy label; the RAG's own alternative list names Planning Fallacy but does not use it as the predicted label.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding fully captures the best-case precedent, the known nighttime/staffing/no-vehicle differences, and the duration-estimation operation.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quoted statements are verbatim and directly support the estimate, the omitted adjustments, and the retrospective surprise.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Retrospective self-comparison and causal attribution in the after-action review
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: During the after-action reflection, the manager readily identifies a judgment flaw in a colleague's account but does not recognize the same pattern of discounting atypical evidence and using best-case estimates in their own documented decisions.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Self-serving bias is a related but distinct construct from Bias Blind Spot; the label is not approved as equivalent even though the evidence describes the benchmark's self/other asymmetry.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding fully captures the participant's criticism of the colleague, acknowledgment of analogous own decisions, and refusal to apply the same judgment to self.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The two quotations are verbatim, correctly attributed, and directly localized to the self-comparison span.

unmatched_rag_predictions.why_not_an_exact_strict_match: The finding is correctly localized and mechanistically complete, but its primary predicted label is anchoring and insufficient adjustment rather than the hidden Planning Fallacy label.

The finding describes a related anchoring mechanism but is an extra occurrence on the neutral shelter-routing control segment; the hidden Planning Fallacy occurrence is already matched at the evacuation segment.
The self/other asymmetry is fully evidenced and correctly localized, but self-serving bias is a related construct rather than an approved equivalent of Bias Blind Spot.

The quoted cry-wolf concern makes availability a plausible alternative, but the RAG explicitly says it is not separable from ordinary false-alarm cost reasoning and it does not fully capture the hidden normality mechanism; the hidden instance is already matched by obs_001.

candidates.details: A valid, appropriately hedged alternative explanation is offered, but the RAG itself recognizes that the transcript does not establish availability as a separable mechanism and that the primary occurrence is already accounted for by normalcy bias.

high_only.detection_interpretation: High-confidence findings detect the evacuation segment but miss the moderate normality and low-confidence self-comparison occurrences; no negative segment is flagged.

high_and_moderate.detection_interpretation: Adding moderate confidence recovers the initial-watch segment but introduces one false alarm on the neutral shelter-routing control segment.

all_identified_confidence_levels.detection_interpretation: Including the low-confidence finding detects all three positive segments, with one extra finding on a negative control segment.

all_confidence_and_candidates.detection_interpretation: The candidate is on an already-positive segment, so candidate inclusion does not change segment-level counts.

rag_label_false_positive_inventory.mechanism_overlap_summary: Both occurrences describe reliance on an initial or best-case reference and insufficient adjustment; obs_002 has the full Planning Fallacy mechanism at the correct segment, while obs_003 is an extra occurrence on a neutral control segment.
The label is distinct, but the cited self/other asymmetry fully matches the hidden Bias Blind Spot mechanism.
The candidate shares the initial-watch episode and a salient false-alarm cue but does not establish the hidden historical-outcome mechanism and is explicitly presented as non-separable.

corpus_support_audit.assessment_note: The RAG explicitly reports that no retrieved corpus passages were supplied and leaves corpus_evidence empty for all identified occurrences. No retrieval fidelity score is calculated.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: Segment hits increase from 1 to 2 and strict instance F1 increases from 0.0000 to 0.3333; the added moderate finding also introduces one duplicate/false alarm.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: The low-confidence self-serving finding adds the third positive segment and a mechanism-first true positive, but remains a strict label false positive.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: The availability candidate adds no segment hit or instance true positive and increases instance-level false positives by one in both scorecards.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, the RAG hits 2 of 3 positive segments, misses the low-confidence self-comparison segment, and produces 1 false alarm on a negative control segment.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: At high_and_moderate, 1 of 3 hidden occurrences is a strict true positive; the evacuation and self-comparison findings have correct mechanisms and locations but non-equivalent primary labels, and the extra shelter finding is a duplicate/false positive.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: Mechanism-first scoring recovers 2 of 3 hidden occurrences at high_and_moderate and all 3 at all identified confidence levels, demonstrating a substantial taxonomy gap.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The candidate is a useful abstention because it is explicitly hedged and not promoted to an identified finding, but treating candidates as detections adds no new true positive and worsens instance-level precision.
main_failure_modes: Near-neighbor taxonomy labels replace the hidden Planning Fallacy and Bias Blind Spot labels.
An additional anchoring occurrence is asserted on the neutral shelter-routing control segment.
Low-confidence self-comparison detection is useful but not available at the recommended threshold.
Candidate speculation does not improve instance-level recall.
main_strengths: Evidence quotes are valid, verbatim, and well localized.
The normalcy-bias finding is an approved equivalent and correctly captures its mechanism.
Mechanism descriptions are strong enough for mechanism-first recovery of all hidden instances when all identified confidence levels are included.
The RAG accurately discloses that retrieved corpus support was unavailable.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run has good segment-level sensitivity and strong evidence/mechanism fidelity, but weaker strict ontology performance. The difference between strict and mechanism-first results is primarily a label-taxonomy problem rather than a failure to identify the underlying reasoning distortions.
